questions.scenario: Yeast cells were grown in a closed flask containing a glucose solution at 25 °C. The number of yeast cells was counted every 2 hours.
questions.scenarioAf: Gisselle is in ’n geslote fles met ’n glukose-oplossing by 25 °C gekweek. Die aantal gisselle is elke 2 uur getel.

questions.q: Name the shape of the growth curve that these results produce.
questions.qAf: Noem die vorm van die groeikurwe wat hierdie resultate lewer.
points: sigmoid (S-shaped)
pointsAf: sigmoïed (S-vormig)

questions.q: Name the phase of growth between 0 and 2 hours.
questions.qAf: Noem die groeifase tussen 0 en 2 uur.
points: lag phase
pointsAf: sloerfase (lagfase)

questions.q: Name the phase of growth between 4 and 8 hours.
questions.qAf: Noem die groeifase tussen 4 en 8 uur.
points: exponential (log) phase
pointsAf: eksponensiële (log-) fase

questions.q: Explain why the population stops increasing after about 10 hours.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die bevolking ná ongeveer 10 uur ophou toeneem.
points: The glucose (food) starts to run out
waste products such as alcohol build up
so the death rate becomes equal to the birth rate
pointsAf: Die glukose (voedsel) begin opraak
afvalprodukte soos alkohol hoop op
dus word die sterftesyfer gelyk aan die geboortesyfer

questions.q: Estimate the carrying capacity of the flask.
questions.qAf: Skat die drakrag van die fles.

pointsAf: ongeveer 41 miljoen selle per cm³

y-axis: number of yeast cells (millions per cm³) with a suitable scale
All points plotted correctly
pointsAf: Korrekte soort grafiek (lyngrafiek)
Opskrif wat albei veranderlikes noem
x-as: tyd (ure) met ’n geskikte skaal
y-as: aantal gisselle (miljoene per cm³) met ’n geskikte skaal
Al die punte korrek gestip

questions.q: Name ONE variable that was kept constant.
questions.qAf: Noem EEN veranderlike wat konstant gehou is.

questions.q: Is the yeast population an open or a closed population? Give a reason.
questions.qAf: Is die gisbevolking ’n oop of ’n geslote bevolking? Gee ’n rede.
points: Closed, because no cells can move in or out of the flask (no migration)
pointsAf: Geslote, omdat geen selle die fles kan binnegaan of verlaat nie (geen migrasie nie)

questions.q: Write a balanced chemical equation for aerobic respiration.
questions.qAf: Skryf ’n gebalanseerde chemiese vergelyking vir aërobiese respirasie.
points: C₆H₁₂O₆ + O₂ (reactants)
→ CO₂ + H₂O + energy (ATP) (products)
balanced: C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ → 6CO₂ + 6H₂O
pointsAf: C₆H₁₂O₆ + O₂ (reaktanse)
→ CO₂ + H₂O + energie (ATP) (produkte)
gebalanseer: C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ → 6CO₂ + 6H₂O

questions.q: Name the THREE stages of aerobic respiration and state where in the cell each takes place.
questions.qAf: Noem die DRIE stadiums van aërobiese respirasie en noem waar in die sel elkeen plaasvind.
points: glycolysis
in the cytoplasm
Krebs cycle
in the matrix of the mitochondrion
oxidative phosphorylation (electron transport chain)
on the inner membrane (cristae) of the mitochondrion
pointsAf: glikolise
in die sitoplasma
Krebs-siklus
in die matriks van die mitochondrion
oksidatiewe fosforilering (elektronoordragketting)
op die binneste membraan (cristae) van die mitochondrion

questions.q: Tabulate TWO differences between aerobic and anaerobic respiration.
questions.qAf: Tabuleer TWEE verskille tussen aërobiese en anaërobiese respirasie.
points: Aerobic: uses oxygen / Anaerobic: no oxygen is used
Aerobic: produces a lot of ATP (about 36 per glucose) / Anaerobic: produces little ATP (2 per glucose)
pointsAf: Aërobies: gebruik suurstof / Anaërobies: geen suurstof word gebruik nie
Aërobies: produseer baie ATP (ongeveer 36 per glukose) / Anaërobies: produseer min ATP (2 per glukose)

questions.q: Explain why muscles become tired and sore during strenuous exercise.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom spiere tydens strawwe oefening moeg en seer word.
points: Not enough oxygen reaches the muscles
so the muscle cells also respire anaerobically
and lactic acid builds up, causing fatigue and cramps
pointsAf: Nie genoeg suurstof bereik die spiere nie
dus respireer die spierselle ook anaërobies
en melksuur hoop op, wat moegheid en krampe veroorsaak

questions.qAf: Gee EEN industriële gebruik van alkoholiese gisting.
points: baking bread, or brewing beer and making wine

questions.q: A learner blows through limewater for a minute. Describe and explain what is observed.
questions.qAf: ’n Leerder blaas vir ’n minuut deur kalkwater. Beskryf en verduidelik wat waargeneem word.
points: The limewater turns milky
because carbon dioxide is present
exhaled air contains more carbon dioxide, which is produced by cellular respiration
pointsAf: Die kalkwater word melkerig
omdat koolstofdioksied teenwoordig is
uitgeasemde lug bevat meer koolstofdioksied, wat deur sellulêre respirasie geproduseer word

questions.q: Distinguish between breathing, gaseous exchange and cellular respiration.
questions.qAf: Onderskei tussen asemhaling, gaswisseling en sellulêre respirasie.
points: Breathing: moving air into and out of the lungs
Gaseous exchange: the diffusion of oxygen and carbon dioxide across a gas-exchange surface
Cellular respiration: the breakdown of glucose in cells to release energy
pointsAf: Asemhaling: die beweging van lug in en uit die longe
Gaswisseling: die diffusie van suurstof en koolstofdioksied oor ’n gaswisselingsoppervlak
Sellulêre respirasie: die afbreek van glukose in selle om energie vry te stel

questions.q: Give FOUR features of an efficient gas-exchange surface.
questions.qAf: Gee VIER kenmerke van ’n doeltreffende gaswisselingsoppervlak.
points: a large surface area
thin (short diffusion distance)
moist
a good blood supply (and ventilation)
pointsAf: ’n groot oppervlakte
dun (kort diffusie-afstand)
klam
’n goeie bloedtoevoer (en ventilasie)

questions.q: Describe the process of inhalation.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die proses van inaseming.
points: The external intercostal muscles contract and the ribs move up and out
the diaphragm contracts and flattens
the volume of the thoracic cavity increases, so the pressure inside decreases
air moves into the lungs
pointsAf: Die buitenste tussenribspiere trek saam en die ribbes beweeg op en uit
die diafragma trek saam en word plat
die volume van die borsholte neem toe, dus neem die druk binne af
lug beweeg die longe binne

questions.q: Describe how oxygen and carbon dioxide are exchanged in an alveolus.
questions.qAf: Beskryf hoe suurstof en koolstofdioksied in ’n alveolus uitgeruil word.
points: Oxygen diffuses from the alveolus into the blood
because its concentration is higher in the alveolus than in the blood
carbon dioxide diffuses from the blood into the alveolus
pointsAf: Suurstof diffundeer van die alveolus na die bloed
omdat sy konsentrasie in die alveolus hoër is as in die bloed
koolstofdioksied diffundeer van die bloed na die alveolus

questions.q: Explain how an increase in the carbon dioxide level of the blood changes the breathing rate.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe ’n toename in die koolstofdioksiedvlak van die bloed die asemhalingstempo verander.
points: Receptors detect the higher carbon dioxide level
the medulla oblongata sends more impulses to the breathing muscles
so breathing becomes faster and deeper, and more carbon dioxide is exhaled
pointsAf: Reseptore neem die hoër koolstofdioksiedvlak waar
die medulla oblongata stuur meer impulse na die asemhalingspiere
dus word asemhaling vinniger en dieper, en meer koolstofdioksied word uitgeasem

questions.q: Give TWO ways in which smoking reduces the efficiency of gaseous exchange.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE maniere waarop rook die doeltreffendheid van gaswisseling verminder.
points: Tar and smoke damage the alveolar walls, which reduces the surface area (emphysema)
carbon monoxide binds to haemoglobin, so less oxygen is carried
pointsAf: Teer en rook beskadig die alveolêre wande, wat die oppervlakte verminder (emfiseem)
koolstofmonoksied bind aan hemoglobien, dus word minder suurstof vervoer

= 200 fish

questions.q: Give TWO assumptions made when this method is used.

points: The marks do not affect the survival of the fish, and the marked fish mix evenly with the others

questions.q: Name TWO factors that increase the size of a population.

questions.q: Distinguish between density-dependent and density-independent factors, and give an example of each.
questions.qAf: Onderskei tussen digtheidsafhanklike en digtheidsonafhanklike faktore, en gee ’n voorbeeld van elk.
points: Density-dependent: their effect increases as the population becomes denser
e.g. competition for food, or disease
Density-independent: affect the population regardless of its density
e.g. floods, fire or drought
pointsAf: Digtheidsafhanklik: hul effek neem toe soos die bevolking digter word
bv. kompetisie vir voedsel, of siekte
Digtheidsonafhanklik: beïnvloed die bevolking ongeag sy digtheid

questions.q: Describe how the numbers of a predator and its prey change over time.
questions.qAf: Beskryf hoe die getalle van ’n roofdier en sy prooi oor tyd verander.
points: When the prey increases, the predators have more food and increase a little later
more predators eat more prey, so the prey decreases
with less food the predators then decrease, and the cycle repeats
pointsAf: Wanneer die prooi toeneem, het die roofdiere meer voedsel en neem hulle ’n bietjie later toe
meer roofdiere eet meer prooi, dus neem die prooi af

questions.q: Define ecological succession.
questions.qAf: Definieer ekologiese suksessie.
points: The gradual change in the species that make up a community over time
until a stable climax community forms
pointsAf: Die geleidelike verandering in die spesies wat ’n gemeenskap uitmaak oor tyd
totdat ’n stabiele klimaksgemeenskap vorm

questions.q: Explain the enhanced greenhouse effect.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik die versterkte kweekhuiseffek.
points: Burning fossil fuels and cutting down forests increase the carbon dioxide in the atmosphere
greenhouse gases trap more of the heat (infrared radiation) given off by the Earth
so the average global temperature rises (global warming)
pointsAf: Die verbranding van fossielbrandstowwe en die afkap van woude verhoog die koolstofdioksied in die atmosfeer
kweekhuisgasse vang meer van die hitte (infrarooi straling) wat die Aarde afgee
dus styg die gemiddelde globale temperatuur (aardverwarming)

questions.q: Give TWO possible effects of climate change in South Africa.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE moontlike gevolge van klimaatsverandering in Suid-Afrika.
points: more frequent and severe droughts
more extreme storms and floods, rising sea levels, or loss of biodiversity
pointsAf: meer gereelde en ernstige droogtes
meer uiterste storms en vloede, stygende seevlakke, of verlies aan biodiversiteit

questions.q: Describe how fertiliser that washes into a dam can lead to the death of fish (eutrophication).
questions.qAf: Beskryf hoe kunsmis wat in ’n dam inspoel tot die dood van visse kan lei (eutrofikasie).
points: The fertiliser adds nitrates and phosphates to the water
algae grow very quickly (an algal bloom)
when the algae die, bacteria decompose them and use up the oxygen
the oxygen level drops and the fish die
pointsAf: Die kunsmis voeg nitrate en fosfate by die water
alge groei baie vinnig (’n algbloei)
wanneer die alge sterf, ontbind bakterieë hulle en gebruik die suurstof op
die suurstofvlak daal en die visse sterf

questions.q: Explain how alien invasive plants threaten South Africa’s water supply.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe uitheemse indringerplante Suid-Afrika se watervoorraad bedreig.
points: Many invasive plants use much more water than indigenous plants
so less water flows into rivers and dams
pointsAf: Baie indringerplante gebruik baie meer water as inheemse plante
dus vloei minder water in riviere en damme

questions.q: Name ONE alien invasive plant found in South Africa.
questions.qAf: Noem EEN uitheemse indringerplant wat in Suid-Afrika voorkom.
points: Port Jackson willow, black wattle, water hyacinth or prickly pear

questions.q: What is meant by food security?
questions.qAf: Wat word bedoel met voedselsekuriteit?
points: When all people always have access to enough safe and nutritious food
pointsAf: Wanneer alle mense altyd toegang het tot genoeg veilige en voedsame voedsel

questions.q:
Describe how urine is formed in a nephron, and explain how ADH helps to keep the water level of the blood constant.
Content: 17 Synthesis: 3
NOTE: NO marks will be awarded for answers in the form of flow charts, tables or diagrams.
questions.qAf:
Beskryf hoe urine in ’n nefron gevorm word, en verduidelik hoe ADH help om die watervlak van die bloed konstant te hou.
Inhoud: 17 Sintese: 3
LET WEL: GEEN punte sal toegeken word vir antwoorde in die vorm van vloeidiagramme, tabelle of diagramme nie.
points: Blood enters the glomerulus through the afferent arteriole
The efferent arteriole is narrower, so the blood pressure in the glomerulus is high
Water, glucose, amino acids, salts and urea are forced into Bowman’s capsule (ultrafiltration)
Blood cells and large proteins stay in the blood
In the proximal convoluted tubule all the glucose and amino acids are reabsorbed (selective reabsorption)
Most of the water and salts are also reabsorbed there
The tubule cells have microvilli and many mitochondria for active transport
Water and salts are reabsorbed in the loop of Henle
Substances such as H⁺ and K⁺ ions and drugs are secreted into the distal tubule (tubular secretion)
The collecting duct carries the urine to the renal pelvis and ureter
When the water level in the blood is low, the hypothalamus detects the change
The pituitary gland secretes more ADH
ADH makes the walls of the distal tubule and collecting duct more permeable to water
More water is reabsorbed and a small volume of concentrated urine is produced
When the water level is high, less ADH is secreted
The walls become less permeable, so less water is reabsorbed
A large volume of dilute urine is produced
pointsAf: Bloed kom die glomerulus deur die aanvoerende arteriool binne
Die afvoerende arteriool is nouer, dus is die bloeddruk in die glomerulus hoog
Water, glukose, aminosure, soute en ureum word in Bowman se kapsel ingedruk (ultrafiltrasie)
Bloedselle en groot proteïene bly in die bloed
In die proksimale kronkelbuisie word al die glukose en aminosure herabsorbeer (selektiewe herabsorpsie)
Die meeste van die water en soute word ook daar herabsorbeer
Die buisieselle het mikrovilli en baie mitochondria vir aktiewe transport
Water en soute word in die lus van Henle herabsorbeer
Stowwe soos H⁺- en K⁺-ione en medisyne word in die distale buisie afgeskei (buisiesekresie)
Die versamelbuis vervoer die urine na die nierbekken en ureter
Wanneer die watervlak in die bloed laag is, neem die hipotalamus die verandering waar
Die pituïtêre klier skei meer ADH af
ADH maak die wande van die distale buisie en versamelbuis meer deurlaatbaar vir water
Meer water word herabsorbeer en ’n klein volume gekonsentreerde urine word geproduseer
Wanneer die watervlak hoog is, word minder ADH afgeskei
Die wande word minder deurlaatbaar, dus word minder water herabsorbeer
’n Groot volume verdunde urine word geproduseer

questions.qAf: Sintese
points: Relevance (1): all the information is about urine formation and ADH; nothing irrelevant

pointsAf: Relevansie (1): al die inligting gaan oor urinevorming en ADH; niks irrelevant nie
Logiese volgorde (1): die prosesse word in volgorde deur die nefron beskryf
Omvattend (1): ten minste 7/10 vir urinevorming en 5/7 vir ADH
